items.html: Know and understand that through the Yenika of ZA, all the VAK of ZA were completed. And the truth is that in relation to themselves they are also a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, for even the small one necessarily has a head. However, all these ten Sefirot are called the aspect of VAK, in relation to all the aspects of ZA in their completeness. For these ten Sefirot of the Partzuf of Yenika become for him afterwards only the aspect of VAK, and the ten Sefirot of the Partzuf of the Mochin of Gadlut, called Tzelem, as mentioned, become for him the Mochin, which are KHB.
